capabilities: Add colored underlines to headings by level
Set underline width to the last or widest line of multi-line headings
Adjust appearance options via Style Settings
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; installation is via BRAT or a manual zip download, and manual installs require checking for updates by hand.
intentEvidence: CSS alone can't set the underline width to the width of the last line or the widest line in a multi-line heading.
motivation: The author wanted per-level heading underlines whose width matches the last or widest line of a heading, which CSS alone cannot do.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to color-code heading levels, and plain CSS cannot size an underline to the last or widest line of a multi-line heading.

relations.evidence: Appearance options can be tweaked in Style Settings.
Download and enable the BRAT plugin.

summary: Heading styling plugin that adds colored underlines to headings to visually distinguish heading levels.
